purpose: An ordered list of the steps of a short, linear flow, showing which step is active, which are done and which failed. Vertical or horizontal.

notFor.case: Progress of one task with no named steps.
Showing where a page sits in a hierarchy.

Default.visual: Markers joined by connector lines, each with a title and an optional description; Size and Orientation cascade to every item.

a11y.keyboard: None in the contract: the steps are list items, not controls.
notes: An ordered list that needs an accessible name.
The active step is aria-current="step"; disabled ones aria-disabled.

openQuestions: Should a completed step be pressable to go back to it, or is the Stepper always display-only?
